title: Resume, end and custody
description: Relay cleanup rechecks an ungrouped record with the same process-identity observer used by its dead-session report. A missing or reused identity permits cleanup; an observation error retains the record. Process-group records retain custody while a member survives or group ownership remains unresolved.
evidence: Source tests cover the original cleanup consumer, injected absent/reused/live/unavailable identities, and live/unresolved/gone groups. This is source proof, not released live proof.
